title: HoloMedMessageEnvelope
description: Canonical message envelope format for all HoloMed AI inter-subsystem communication.

protocol_version.description: Semantic protocol version in MAJOR.MINOR format without leading zeroes.

message_id.description: Canonical lowercase UUIDv4 uniquely identifying this message.

correlation_id.description: Canonical lowercase UUID tracing the root operation/transaction.

causation_id.description: Canonical lowercase UUID of the direct parent message causing this message, or null for root messages.

message_name.description: Lowercase dot-separated semantic topic or action name.

source.description: Lowercase dot-separated identifier of the originating subsystem.

target.description: Lowercase dot-separated destination identifier, or null for unaddressed broadcast messages.

timestamp_utc.description: Strict ISO 8601 UTC timestamp with 6-digit microsecond precision and trailing Z suffix.

payload.description: Domain-specific message payload object or ErrorPayload.

metadata.description: Contextual protocol, tracing, and routing metadata.
